segments.name: West
products: construction aggregates (crushed stone and sand and gravel)
segments.description: Mines aggregates and produces asphalt and ready-mix concrete, with contracting services, serving public and private customers in Alaska, California, Hawaii, Oregon and Washington.
segments.evidence: Our former Pacific and Northwest operating segments were combined to form the new West operating segment.

segments.name: Mountain
products: construction aggregates (crushed stone and sand and gravel)
segments.description: Mines aggregates and produces asphalt and ready-mix concrete, with contracting services, serving public and private customers in Idaho, Montana and Wyoming.
segments.evidence: The reorganization resulted in four operating segments: West, Mountain, Central and Energy Services, each of which is also a reportable segment.

segments.name: Central
products: construction aggregates (crushed stone and sand and gravel)
segments.description: Mines aggregates and produces asphalt and ready-mix concrete, with contracting services, serving public and private customers in Iowa, Minnesota, North Dakota, South Dakota and Texas.
segments.evidence: Our former North Central and South operating segments were combined to form the new Central operating segment.

segments.name: Energy Services
segments.description: Produces and supplies liquid asphalt, mainly for asphalt road construction, and serves the company's other segments and outside customers.
segments.evidence: The Energy Services segment, which has locations throughout our geographic footprint, produces and supplies liquid asphalt, primarily for use in asphalt road construction, and is a supplier to some of our other segments.

revenueModel.text: Public and private customers pay for construction materials and contracting services such as highways, roads, bridges and site development.
revenueModel.evidence: Our construction materials are sold to public and private-sector customers, including federal, state and municipal governments, as well as industrial, commercial and residential developers and other private parties.

changes.text: In January 2025, the former Pacific and Northwest operating segments were combined to form the new West operating segment.
changes.evidence: Our former Pacific and Northwest operating segments were combined to form the new West operating segment.

changes.text: In January 2025, the former North Central and South operating segments were combined to form the new Central operating segment.
changes.evidence: Our former North Central and South operating segments were combined to form the new Central operating segment.
